asked if the lot numbering system for BLA is the same or it is different than the EUA lot numbering. Pfizer replied that it will likely be the same. Pfizer committed to provide (1) a proposal on how licensed material will be identified and draft wording to be used and (2) list of vaccine lots that meet licensure standards in the field, to FDA soon. Pfizer also stated that they are planning to submit lot release protocols (LRPs) for the lots by Monday, August 16, 2021. END (b) (4) (b) (4) (b) (4) (b) (4) FDA-CBER-2021-5683-1024780
